lines.dialogue: This job is eating me alive. I can't breathe anymore.
I spent all these years trying to be the good guy, the man in the white hat. I'm not becoming like them... I am them.

I’m doing the best speech from “Donnie Brasco.” Actually-- --ten of me are doing the best speech from “Donnie Brasco.” ‘Sup? AMY Get it together, man. All ten of you. AMY (CONT’D) Store was hit about two hours ago. Perps disabled the alarm-- JAKE Sorry! My bad. AMY They mostly took tablets and cameras.
DO YOU BELIEVE IN LIFE AFTER LOVE? --
I know, not my first choice either, but it’s stuck. Got any other songs, Ahmed?

You literally just said it was broken. I THINK THIS ROBB-RY WAS A SMASH AND GRAB / I REALLY BELIEVE IT WAS A SMASH AND GRAB, OH!!! AMY Really, Cher? I think it was an inside job. Prove me wrong. JAKE A challenge? Is this a challenge? I love challenges! The door and the register were both forced, and they tripped a motion sensor -- i.e., not an inside job. AMY Or it’s an inside job meant to look like a smash and grab.
Sorry. We’re looking for three white males, one of whom has tatt sleeves on both arms.
I had a confidential informant on the inside. He spent years right here, in this sale bin, watching, learning, waiting. His code name is... Fuzzy Cuddle Bear! And he’s a nanny cam.
You know what they say: Luck is 95% talent, 5% being awesome.
Whelp... we did it, Fuzzy. We got ‘em. You can come home now. “I don’t know if I can. I’ve been undercover so long, I don’t even know who I am anymore. I’ve done terrible things.”
“I strangled a Mr. Potato Head with my bare hands. Oh God, what have I become?!”
Patrol picked up all three mopes yesterday, Sarge. Would you like to do the honor?
I will!
Early this morning, someone decided to shoot and kill luxury food importer Harry Morgenthau. Body was discovered by his cleaning lady.
During her interview, using expert detective work, I deduced that she had something super gross on her chin. I took a picture of it, as evidence.
Charles thinks it was flan. I think it was butterscotch pudding.
Oh, are you hoping to be put in charge of the Brown Noser Squad, Sergeant Asskisser?
That’s exactly what I said.
Just got these crime scene photos -- look at the victim’s socks.
No, just -- they’re super nice socks, right? Where do you get socks like that? I have the worst socks.
No, and I don’t care. Terry runs the detective squad, and he’s great.
Yes, but he’s our emotional wreck. I wish Captain McGintly had never left. He was the best. AMY He was terrible. You just liked him because he let you do anything you wanted.
Fire extinguisher roller chair derby.

Sorry, dude. This new guy’s gonna be a washed-up pencil pusher, who’s forgotten how to be a cop, and is only concerned with -- -- following every rule in the Patrol Guide, meep morp robot captain engage.
Hey! You must be the new C.O. Detective Jake Peralta. Great to meet you.
Well, lemme see... ”washed-up pencil- pusher”... ”forgotten how to be a cop”... I think I was done, actually.
...“Meep morp... zeep... robot...”
Our old captain didn’t care if we wore ties.
What? You always go in first. Look at you -- those biceps don’t go in “second.”
I think he’s dead.

Okay. Perp came in through the window, left that muddy footprint, broke that cabinet -- hold on, hold on. Is everyone wearing a necktie? Because it’s impossible to solve crimes if you’re not wearing a tie.
I concur. Good work, detective. You get a tie.
That’s right, Boyle. Good solve.
First of all, it’s very weird to hear a Cuban woman refer to an African American man as her rabbi. Secondly, your “rabbi’s” a pain in my ass.
A ham for $6000? Is it from a talking pig? Is it made out of “Babe: Pig in the City?”
A murder and a ham heist? Things just got interesting. This is Captain Ray Holt. We’re gonna need some extra ties.
You gotta be kidding me. Hi Captain! What are you doing here?
Door duty? It’s a waste of time.
I think he’s starting to like me!
Let the wasting of time begin.
What?
The reward is a six-toed prince?!
Yeah, that checks out.
So, just like it sounds.
Has anyone in the history of police work ever solved a crime by doing door duty?
Well, I doubt you’re going to meet the future Mr. Santiago in this hallway.
I’ll take that action. Police, open up please.
Hello, sir! My name is Detective Right- All-The-Time, and this is my partner, Detective Terribledetective.
None of the neighbors heard or saw anything. And what’s worse, Santiago struck out with a 90 year-old. Hard. It was embarrassing.
Oh, I’m wearing a tie right now. Check it out:
Secret tie!
Because, sir, if you’re wound too tight, you end up like Terry.
Crying at your desk and playing with sock puppets.
Are we just naming positive things? Rainbows. Kittens. Thanksgiving dinner!
Well, I was curious whether you thought I was doing too much man-scaping, and apparently you do, so I’m good.
Hey, what about that expensive jamon iber-crap stuff? The perp left a really expensive TV behind, but stole ham? Is there a place near the crime scene that sells it?
Okay, Ratko. Just a few questions. Do you recognize him? Henry Morgenthau?
Look at the picture first, maybe, Ratko.

Okay, I’ll tell you what happened. He came by and said he had some hams to sell. You knew they were worth a lot of money, so you tried to rob him when he wasn’t home. Only he was home, and he fought back, so you shot him. Am I close? Nod your giant caveman head and drool if I’m close. JAKE (CONT’D) Oh man, I hate running! Ratko stop! Stop Ratko! JAKE (CONT’D) Ow! Ratko, I’m getting mad. CHARLES That’s thirty dollar marmalade! RATKO (O.S.) I not mean to kill. It not my fault. JAKE Okay. Okay. I believe you. Be cool.
Good news is: we found the murderer. Ratko Slovic, a Serbian butcher. Robbery gone bad. He confessed and everything.
Charles and I may have allowed Ratko to escape. But, one more piece of good news:
I got you some hazelnut!
He’s seriously assigning me to the records room? Why do we even have a records room? The computer has been invented, right?
Slam! That was a slam! Pretend that slammed.
I was skeptical, but it really did make a difference in my work. I think I found something interesting in these files. Here, let me show you.
...That’s not necessary.

Yes. Well. Thank you all for coming. Including -- oh! -- Craig, our crime scene photographer. JAKE (CONT'D) Great. So. After being unfairly tossed into the records room for no reason, I got so bored I started reading some old cases. HOLT A novel idea. JAKE “Ratko” was a made-up name, but: after looking through a million files, one of which I literally found in a spiderweb, I found a bunch of references to a Serbian thug, street names: “The Rat” and “The Butcher.” Suspect in a few break-ins -- used to hang out at a storage unit near Boerum Park...which has red soil, hence the muddy red footprints on Monganthau’s
Thank you. Thanks. That’s nice.
Well, I for one am very excited to be on a stakeout with you, Captain. You know what my fave part of stakeouts is? Patrol guide says: casual dress.

First off, that’s racist. Second of all, you caught the Disco Strangler, right? That dude wrapped a lot of yo-yos around a lot of hookers’ necks. Nice collar. But the thing I can’t understand is: young superstar detective takes down a serial killer... why’d it take you so long to get your first command?
...Seriously?
Damn. I am not a good detective.
Captain, when I had my pants off, in no way was I... I didn’t know about your gay... gayness.
I feel dumb.
Frankly, yes, I am, and Captain, I’m sorry. But also, look, there’s Ratko. Humility over. I’m amazing.
I see what you did there. Nice.
Hang in there, buddy.
Hello, Ratko.
You’re not going, actually. Because if you’ll just take a quick peek to your right, you’ll see Detectives Boyle and Diaz.

Over there is Detective Santiago. And behind you is Captain Holt. Can you believe that? A captain, on a stakeout! He’s kind of a hands-on dude. Point is, we have you surrounded -- -- oh my God, I figured out the tie thing! Captain -- hey, I figured it out!

It’s a uniform. We’re a team, and ties are part of the uniform for that team. Right. RATKO ...You ask Ratko what team? JAKE No, Ratko, shut up. It’s important to you because you were kept off that team, and now you’re the coach and you want us all to wear the same uniform. Boom. I nailed it.
Oh -- right. Cool. Okay, Ratko, gun down. Get on the ground and put your hands on your --
Ugh. I hate running.
That’s how we do things in the nine-nine, Captain. We catch bad guys, and we look good doing it.
Never took off the speedo. Huge mistake. It is inside me. Great job, team!
Oh, the tux? I’m done with work. This is how I dress in my free time.
Yeah, I don’t want your job. That’s the last thing I want.

Gotta give it up, Santiago took him down hard. Well done. It was sexy. I was very into it. AMY Ugh, just when you’re being sincere, you ruin everything. JAKE Yeah, that’s kind of my move. TERRY Hoo boy. So glad I was not there.
And to Captain Holt...’s best detective, Jake Peralta.
Okay -- you take the little one on the right, I’ll take the big one on the left.
You gotta do it. Santa breaks the law, the law breaks Santa.
Fine. Then I’m going in alone. NYPD! Santa, stop hitting Santa!
What’s going on?
All right, calm down. Boyle, frisk the skinny one.
Fine. I’ll do it. But if I find any presents, I’m keeping them.
Aaargh! Get Santa off me! God, you reek of booze!
Wha-- aw, gross, there’s burrito in his beard!
Knife! Santa has a knife!
No. They do that? Why doesn’t everyone just drop their sandwich on the floor?
And instead you gave me an amazing life hack! I’m smiling because I met someone and I think she may be my soulmate.
Do you have these in any other color?
Nice. ‘Sup?
I know, right? She’s basically Garfield in a hot lady’s body. I’ll take her out for lasagna!
Oh no, Amy, this is embarrassing. I didn’t get you anything. Wait... I did get you something. A nice fresh hot cup of coffee.
Merry Christmas, Chief. And a very merry Christmas to you, Captain. Ho-ho-ho!
Oh! I really came in here with the wrong energy.
Of course, no, totally. Why would a death threat be a big deal? Oh right, because it threatens death.
Awesome. I love secrets! Santiago got you like six presents.
Interesting. And not at all surprising. I’m his favorite. Now what exactly does that job entail? GERBER JAKE
Well. I would gladly put my life at risk for this man...to have to follow all my orders. Thank you. This is the greatest Christmas ever. God bless us, everyone!

Affirmative, Stone Eagle. That’s the Secret Service codename I gave you. I’m just doing my job: watching, protecting, bossing you around. Now, for your safety, please open your internet browser and search for the words “pig” plus “jet skis.” That’s an order.
Whoa whoa whoa -- where are you going, Cold Mountain? I changed your codename.
I’m only asking this for your safety: is it a number one or number two? Your silence indicates number two.
Coast is clear, sir. Go go go!
Cold Mountain is on the move. Cold Mountain is rolling to the can.
Well well well. We meet again. Where exactly do you think you’re going?
Negative, Ice Veins -- I changed your code name again -- you’re not going anywhere.
Because I am a 21st century Sherlock Holmes. Boyle is my Watson, and Santiago is my Moriarty. I will defeat her.
Okay. But your house is off-limits -- protocol. If you really want to get out of here, we can go to my mom’s place. Or, I can lock in you the holding cell with an armed escort. Totally your call.
You’ll love it. She has a great internet connection. Not bragging, just true.
Soooo, this is my mom’s house. Just throw your coat in the closet.
...Water closet. My mom is British.
It’s a safe house, son! You been protected!
You refused to stay at your desk, you evaded your protection detail. Sorry: I’m ordering you to stay. God, I love giving you orders!
Oh no! We’re handcuffed together and we’ve lost the key! Falconer One to HQ: Stone Eagle is in the cage. Repeat: Stone Eagle is in the cage.
I know you think I’m just goofing around, but I was ordered to protect you -- by your boss. From here on out, we are in lockdown.
Too late, you’re in it.
Fine. But for security reasons, I get to craft the message.
Let’s start with a nice greeting, like “Hello, honey.”
Copy that -- “honey” isn’t right. “Hello, husband?” “Hello, sir?” You call each other ‘sir’?
Fine. I’ll give you some privacy.
Okay, my safe house, my rules: this is a no-tie zone.
Aaaaaah.
Oh no. This is all part of a detailed security protocol. Phase one: no ties. Phase two: sandwiches.
A hungry safe house is an unsafe-safe house.
It’s terrible! Try it.
A fun safe house is a safe-safe house.
I win.
A “Safe House”-watching safe house is a safe-safe-house-house!
Wow. I would not have guessed that. Those are the kinds of things you find out when you’re handcuffed together. And that is the true meaning of Christmas.
Who knows we’re here?
Get behind me.
I order you to be quiet. JAKE HOLT
Hands in the air!
Charles, what are you doing here? I thought you had a plane to catch.
I can’t believe you texted Boyle when you said you were texting your husband! As the person who is completely in charge here, I’m very disappointed in you. I’m changing your code name to Bad Boy.
I see what you’re doing there. Tushy.
Well, I’m in charge and I like to say tushy. Charles?
What? Wait a minute. Old precinct? You weren’t going home. You were going to investigate the threat... because it’s not a hoax. It’s real.
You’re lying! You have a tell. When you lie, the corner of your mouth moves. And it just moved.
You’re lyiiiiinngggg!
Don’t do it, Charles. I’m your best friend slash idol. Don’t make me just your idol!
Don’t do it... best friend.
That was not one of the options!
So including letters, emails, and texts from a blocked phone, you’ve received ten threats. How many people have you put away that might want to kill you?
Brag. Charles, read the transcripts of the threats he’s received.
Kind of obvious. Lame.
Better. I would’ve gone the “stapling your face onto my face” route.
That’s strange. “Drowning” and “Deep end.“ It’s like he’s talking about a swimming pool.
A-ha! Who’s Haimes?
The Free-Style Killer?! Why did all the killers you caught have such cool names? The best one I ever arrested was Narrow Shoes Sam. Because --
Looks like you need us. Together we figured out it was Haimes, and together we’re going to find him, because together, we can do anything.
Captain, you’re stubborn and that’s an adorable quality. But you know what’s not an adorable quality? JAKE (CONT’D) CHARLES
I give up! What is going on? Why are you being so weird about this?
Wow. I think I would have really gotten along with Young Ray Holt.

Well, frankly, right now you’re acting like that same brash dumb detective. If you’d really changed, you’d be saying boring responsible stuff like: “Don’t be stupid. Let the detective squad help you. You’re part of a team. I smell like sandalwood.”
Updates. Let’s go. Santiago?
Boyle?
Scully and Hitchcock -- where are we on your special project?
Got him! All right, everyone. Suit up. I know there’s no point in telling you not to come. But you’re staying with me.
Man. You really take the fun out of saving your life. Let’s hit it!
Okay. Haimes is armed and dangerous, so remember: watch your six, keep the radio open, and Santiago -- try to channel your lust for me into your police work. There’s too much at stake.
If things go south, I want you to know: it was an honor being able to order you around.
Yes. What cute little nickname do you call your husband? HOLT Kevin.
It’s ringing. This is so exciting!
That’s Haimes’s phone. Converge on that amazing ring tone. This guy is awesome.
Yes. I knew there was something.
When this is over, we should take a train trip together. Just for fun.
I’m Peralta. Not a big deal. Put the gun down!
We got him! We got him!
Oh my god, sir. It’s happening -- you’re emoting.
Captain, this is our job. Any one of us would’ve taken that bullet.
Oh ho. It appears the student has become the teacher. And the teacher has become--
You’re welcome. Team pop and lock!
Still?! Come on! We saved your life.
Oh my god! We did it! Oh my god!
We’re not going anywhere. What you did was amazing!
No ifs, ands, or butts. Sorry, it’s just right there. Literally -- your butt is right there, in my face.
In the butt. Sorry.
Butt, again sorry--
Ow.
He got shot in the butt.
Nooooo, strong lady!
Charles! Medal of Valor!
For getting shot in the butt!
Oh my god, Charles is getting the same prize as a horse.
Because the horse outranks him! This is amazing!
The horse is pooping on the stage! Sergeant Peanut Butter is pooping on the stage!
Santiago. The bet ends today. Are you ready?
-- to lose. The whole question was, “are you ready to lose?” And you said you were born that way.
If you knew anything about me, you’d say “crushing debt.” I’ll bet whatever, because I’m not losing.
I’m gonna win, so sure: let’s bet the car.
That’s a very firm handshake.

But not for long. In eight hours, I will win and then I will take Santiago on the worst date in the history of the world. You made your bed and now you’re going to lie in it. Don’t worry, “bed” is just metaphorical. Or is it?
Hello, sir, you look very stoic today. Like a majestic old tree--
What?! Oh, right the bet, I totally forgot--
Oh hi, Santiago. Do you have any dietary restrictions that Medieval Times should know about? I’m booking us a table in the middle of the jousting ring!
And I can see that by the absolutely no indicators on your face.
Only if I lose. I’m a terrible sport.
Up by two, Santiago. I hope you got your cats a sitter tonight, because I’d hate for them to be lonely while we’re out on our date, having the time of my life.
Cool brag.
They have the same DNA -- they should only count as one!
Oh no.
Bring in the johns!
I ran a prostitution sting through Vice, and arrested thirty guys for soliciting.
It is if it’s your second offense. Which is the case for ten of these gentlemen. Little trivia -- four of them are actually named John! Ironic. Anyhoo, ten more for Peralta. Accept your fate!
Five... four... three... two... one! It’s over. Jake wins! Amy loses!
Amy Santiago, you have made me the happiest man on Earth. Will you go on the worst date ever with me? You have to say yes!
She said yes! She said yes!
Amy Santiago! Date Time! Time to date! Hi there. Sorry, I’m taken. The woman who lives in that apartment loves me.
Should’ve thought of that before you spent all year losing our bet. Chop chop, there’s a lot of embarrassing to do and not a lot of hours to do it in.
Yes! You look like every girl I ever had a crush on at every Bat Mitzvah. Let me see the bow.
Just like Jenny Gildenhorn. I wish you had braces. Should we get you braces? No -- that’s too much.
Thank you. Believe it or not: they weren’t that expensive.
You know the rules. The date begins now and ends at midnight. I decide what you wear, what you eat, and where we go. Oh, and there’s one last rule.
No matter what happens, you’re not allowed to fall in love with me.
M’lady?
Attention, everyone! Obviously, this is Charles’ night. But forget about that for a second, and admire, take pictures, and comment on every aspect of-- this.
Granted. First of three. Use them wisely.
Congrats again, buddy, I really am proud of you. Still wearing the medal, huh?

Allllright... Well, sorry I can’t stay, but I’ve got a terrible night planned for Amy. First up, the mall Photo Studio for our official date portrait. The picture will be the two of us playing one saxophone. Then, a dinner of peel-and- eat shrimp at a dangerously cheap seafood restaurant. And then: I have contracted a youth choir to serenade us.
Okay, let’s hear it.
They’re gonna sing to her at midnight in the middle of Times Square. She and 5000 German tourists will remember that moment for the rest of their lives.
‘Cause they’re so easy to grab, they’re begging to be pulled.
...What are you saying?
Okay, that’s straight-up insane.
Don’t worry about it. Fourteen hundred dollars. But it’s all on credit cards, so really, five dollars a month for the next 2000 years. I do not like Amy!
Charles, you live in your ex-wife’s new boyfriend’s basement. I don’t think I’m gonna take advice from you.
Attention, everyone! We are about to leave, but now, for the first time as winner and loser, Santiago and I will perform the steerage jig from the film, “Titanic,” which we have in no way practiced.

No. Embarrassing. Please note, when Amy blushes, it starts at the tippy-top of her ears so watch for that! AMY I hate your guts. JAKE Channel that passion into the dance, baby. HOLT Peralta. JAKE Scully. Tag in. SCULLY Okay! HOLT One of our informants just called. We’ve been tracking a crew that lifts cargo from Laguardia. The CI knows where the trucks unload, and I need you to go stake
Don’t even know. Waiting for inspiration.
Fine. But I’m taking Santiago, so the minute we’re done we’re back to the date. Darling? Brief pause. Duty calls.
Oh yeah, it was a cotton-plastic blend. But don’t get too comfortable. We’re gonna catch these guys and get right back to the worst night of your life.
Ugh. I have to cancel our theater reservation.
Then I’ll tell you! It was an interactive musical called, “Uncle Milton’s Crazy Armenian Funeral.” You were going to be dragged on stage to play the nanny he died in bed with.
Don’t worry, there’s plenty of date left, including a grand finale at midnight. CHOIR BOY YOUTH CHOIR JAKE It’s gonna be great. For me and the kids. They get to stay up so late!
Is that the truck? Please let it be-- Nope. “Artisanal Soft Serve.” Thanks a lot, Brooklyn!
Yeah, well, I’m not giving up. There’s still time for us to get back to the worst date of your life.
It’s like a fifty-way tie. Recently I went out with a lady who thought our president’s name was “The Rock Obama.”
Hey, those people left the door open. I bet that roof has a better vantage point.
Hey. That’s offensive. It’s old meat.
Hey, can you hand me the binoculars? They’re in my stakeout bag.
Yeah, I get snacky. Nuts are great for you, they don’t have any fat.
Oh. Yeah, the windows don’t go up.
You really want to know? It reminds me of my first time.

No, not that, my first arrest. Get your disgusting mind out of the gutter. I was two days out of the academy. I’m super nervous. I see a guy run out of a bodega with a handful of cash. I chase him, on foot, for 11 blocks before I catch up to him. I take him down and cuff him against the hood of a car. A green ‘68 Mustang. I look over... ‘for sale’ sign in the window. It was the best day of my life. So I bought the car. And that’s when the debt began.
The doll was in the right -- the robot was resisting arrest.
Dude. Are you trying to catch it in your nose?
It’s Holt. Keep practicing. Peralta.
Eh, that’s okay, Captain. Don’t send the relief team. We’re already here, and I’m kind of curious to see what happens.
Just checking in. How you doing -- any better?
Tell me the truth, if you’d won my car would you really have destroyed it?
Look. There’s our guy.
Just follow my lead. Give me the ring. Now give me some nuts. I’m snacky.
You know what, honey, fine! I’ll ask the guy, will that make you happy?!
Excuse me, sir --
My girlfriend thinks we’re lost.
Idiot?! You know why we’re out here in the middle of the night, Susan?
I was going to propose to you at midnight on the Brooklyn Bridge, where we met.
You know what? This is over. Say goodbye to this ring and everything it stood for!
Don’t tell Susan what to-- NOW! JAKE (CONT’D) AMY
Nice work.
Uhhh, actually, I really need to find that ring -- it cost a fortune.
Nah, it goes on the good date list. You know -- ‘cause we caught the bad guys.
Well, I’m a very mature man.
Oh no! No, no, no, I forgot to cancel--
I’ll take this bullet for you, Amy!
Ew! I deserve a Medal of Valor for this!
